attestation: An isolated AI-assisted reviewer found zero unresolved Critical or High findings on the frozen Retrieval Fabric surface. Targeted tests passed 19 of 19, adversarial probes passed 13 of 13, and the frozen Federation and Larena read-only pilots passed their outcome and denial checks.
claim_boundary: This is an owner-authorized AI-assisted review, not an external human audit. It supports bounded production-read software preparation only and does not authorize stable publication, production writes, live effects, unrestricted federation or managed autonomy.
